def transform(grid):
    split = len(grid[0]) // 2
    left = [row[:split] for row in grid]
    right = [row[split + 1:] for row in grid]
    if any(left[r][c] and right[r][c] for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(split)):
        return left
    return [[right[r][c] if right[r][c] else left[r][c] for c in range(split)] for r in range(len(grid))]
